question: Tell me about a time you had a strong disagreement with a teammate regarding a technical decision. How did you handle it and what was the outcome?
Describe a project or task that did not go as planned. What mistakes were made, what did you learn, and how did you adapt for future projects?
Tell me about a time when you had to learn a completely new framework, language, or domain on short notice to deliver a critical project.
Describe a situation where a major project had unclear requirements, no designated lead, and looming deadlines. How did you step up to drive alignment and execution?
Describe a high-pressure situation where multiple critical bugs landed in production simultaneously. How did you prioritize tasks and stay composed?
Tell me about a time you worked with someone whose working style or background was completely different from yours. How did you build a successful working relationship?
Have you ever faced pressure to manipulate data, cut safety corners, or ignore ethical boundaries to meet a company target? How did you respond?
How do you handle having 3 high-priority tasks assigned to you by different managers with the same deadline?
Describe an instance where you identified an inefficiency in an existing process and proposed an innovative solution that improved team productivity.
Tell me about a time you received harsh negative feedback from end-users regarding a feature you built. How did you process it and turn it into an improvement?
